item.title: MLGW warned customers utility bill spike was coming, CEO says
item.description: MEMPHIS, Tenn. — Seeing sticker shock this month when you open your MLGW bill? MLGW President and CEO Doug McGowen says his team expected this and warned customers after the Mid-South was blanketed in a thick layer of snow and ice for weeks.
